items.title: After Moderna's 'Outsized Run,' It May Be Time For This Bearish Move
items.summary: With potential profit-taking on the horizon, it could mean Moderna's upside is limited in the short-term.

items.title: Moderna Climbs 3% Despite Citigroup’s Downgrade to Sell; BioNTech Inches Higher, Pfizer Treads Water
items.summary: Citigroup just told investors to sell Moderna and the stock responded by climbing 3%, raising one pointed question about whether pipeline optimism has fully broken free from Wall Street's valuation warnings.

items.title: Is A Cancer Vaccine Coming? Moderna, Merck Boosted By The Buzz
items.summary: Moderna stock rallied by triple digits when positive news rolled in for its cancer vaccine. But is mRNA ready to return to the limelight?

items.title: Moderna, Cerebras, Jabil, HPE, Cal-Maine, Mattel, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: Moderna falls after Citi downgrades shares to Sell from Hold, saying its recent rally has gone too far.

items.title: Why Moderna (MRNA) Shares Are Falling Today
items.summary: Shares of biotechnology company Moderna (NASDAQ:MRNA) fell 6% in the morning session after Citigroup downgraded the company to Sell from Neutral, warning that a 222% rally had pushed its valuation to unsustainable levels.

items.title: Citi Downgrades Moderna Stock, Warning $80 Billion Valuation Asks Too Much of Cancer Pipeline
items.summary: Citi downgrades Moderna to Sell from Hold, saying the data around its cancer vaccine, instimeran autogene, isn’t enough to justify the valuation.

items.title: After Moderna's Dizzying Rally, It's Time To Sell, Says Analyst
items.summary: After nearly quadrupling over the past month, it's time to get out of Moderna stock, a Citi analyst said Wednesday as he downgraded shares.

items.title: Moderna and Fair Isaac: The Best and Worst S&P 500 Stocks for the Third Quarter
items.summary: Moderna stock has rallied since the company unveiled clinical updates to its cancer vaccine in collaboration with Merck in late August.
